name: 經典香草雪頂意式蘇打
style: Torani 舊金山創始復刻風格
description: 1925 年舊金山 North Beach 意式咖啡館的元祖配方。醇厚馬達加斯加香草、清冽氣泡水與絲滑厚奶油在碎冰間翻滾，頂部擠上鮮打鮮奶油與一顆紅潤黑櫻桃。

ingredients.name: 冰鎮天然氣泡水 / 俱樂部蘇打
ingredients.amazonSearchQuery: San Pellegrino Sparkling Natural Mineral Water

ingredients.name: Half-and-Half 半乳鮮奶油 (或淡奶油)

steps.title: 泵入香草糖漿
steps.instruction: 在 16oz 高球柯林杯底部精準壓入 4 泵 (約 30ml) Torani 法式香草糖漿。
steps.tip: 先放糖漿再加冰，避免糖漿掛在冰塊表面溶解不均。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 4 pumps (approx. 30ml / 1 oz) of Torani French Vanilla Syrup into the bottom of a 16oz highball glass.
steps.enTip: Syrup first, then ice, ensuring even dissolution without sticking to ice surfaces.

steps.title: 填入八分滿碎冰
steps.instruction: 將小顆粒碎冰 (Pebble Ice) 填入杯中至八分滿，讓冰塊成為液體溫度的緩衝屏障。
steps.tip: 碎冰比大冰塊更容易與奶油產生絲絨般的懸浮視覺效果。
steps.enInstruction: Fill glass 3/4 full with pebble or crushed ice, creating a thermal buffer barrier.
steps.enTip: Pebble ice creates a stunning marbled suspension with the cream.

steps.title: 慢速注入冷藏氣泡水
steps.instruction: 將杯子傾斜 45 度，沿杯壁緩慢注入冰鎮氣泡水至離杯口約 2.5 公分處。
steps.tip: 切勿暴力沖注，溫柔傾倒可保留 90% 以上的碳酸沙口感！
steps.enInstruction: Tilt glass 45° and gently pour chilled club soda down the inner wall until 1 inch from the rim.
steps.enTip: Pour gently to retain over 90% of the carbonation bubbles!

steps.title: 淋上絲滑奶油瀑布
steps.instruction: 用吧勺背部抵住冰塊表面，將 30ml 鮮奶油緩緩淋在最頂部，欣賞雪白奶油如雲霧般向下漫延的壯麗分層。
steps.tip: 香草糖漿酸度為中性，可直接淋入任何乳製品完全不會結塊。
steps.enInstruction: Place the back of a bar spoon against the top ice and slowly drizzle 30ml heavy cream over the spoon.
steps.enTip: Vanilla syrup is non-acidic and blends smoothly with dairy without curdling.

steps.title: 飾以雪頂與櫻桃
steps.instruction: 在杯口擠上一圈蓬鬆鮮奶油花，中央點綴一顆黑櫻桃，插上粗吸管即可呈上！
steps.tip: 喝前用吸管上下輕輕抽動攪拌，感受綿密奶香與強烈氣泡的雙重暴擊。
steps.enInstruction: Top with a swirl of whipped cream and a Maraschino cherry in the center. Enjoy with a straw!
steps.enTip: Stir gently with a straw before drinking to blend bubbly fizz and rich cream.

secretTips: 溫度是意式蘇打的靈魂：氣泡水必須冰至接近 0°C，低溫下二氧化碳溶解度最高，氣泡感持久翻倍。
乳製品建議選擇 Half-and-Half (半鮮奶半淡奶油) 或 36% 動物性厚奶油，奶香更純厚，且質地比牛奶更不易消泡。
enDescription: The original 1925 San Francisco North Beach recipe. Rich Madagascar vanilla, crisp effervescent soda, and smooth heavy cream tumbling through crushed ice, topped with whipped cream and a ruby Maraschino cherry.
enSecretTips: Temperature is the soul of Italian soda: sparkling water should be chilled near 0°C to maximize carbonation fizz.
Choose Half-and-Half or 36% heavy cream for a velvety marbled ribbon that floats effortlessly.

name: 蜜桃厚奶油意式蘇打
style: 經典意式水果雪融特飲
description: 夏日白桃蜜香與純厚鮮奶油的夢幻邂逅。粉嫩桃紅與乳白漸層交融，入口先是白桃爆汁般的清甜氣泡，隨後化為絲緞般的奶香。

ingredients.name: 高脂厚奶油 (Heavy Whipping Cream)
ingredients.note: 高乳脂可防止果酸反應

steps.title: 貼杯與糖漿打底
steps.instruction: 將 2 片白桃薄片緊貼柯林杯內壁，於底部壓入 4 泵蜜桃糖漿。
steps.tip: 貼壁水果能讓成品極具咖啡館主打特飲的精緻感。
steps.enInstruction: Press 2 fresh peach slices against the inside of the glass and add 4 pumps peach syrup to the bottom.
steps.enTip: Pressed fruit creates an authentic café aesthetic.

steps.title: 注冰至八分滿
steps.instruction: 輕柔填入滿杯碎冰，固定住貼壁的水果片。
steps.enInstruction: Gently pack the glass 3/4 full with crushed ice to secure the fruit slices.

steps.title: 慢注入氣泡水並微攪拌
steps.instruction: 注入冰鎮氣泡水至 8 分滿，用吧勺將底部糖漿與氣泡水輕輕抽提兩次混合成淡粉色蜜桃蘇打。
steps.tip: 提前讓糖漿與氣泡水混合，能大幅降低酸性濃度，防止下一步奶油結塊！
steps.enInstruction: Pour chilled sparkling water to 80% full. Use a bar spoon to stir the bottom syrup into the soda.
steps.enTip: Diluting syrup with soda reduces acidity and prevents cream from curdling!

steps.title: 漂浮厚奶油雪頂
steps.instruction: 沿冰塊最頂部緩緩倒入 30ml 厚奶油，形成頂部奶白、底部透粉的絕美夕陽漸層。
steps.enInstruction: Slowly drizzle 30ml heavy cream over the top ice, creating a gorgeous sunset gradient.

secretTips: 【避坑指南】桃子糖漿帶有微量果酸，請務必使用乳脂含量 30% 以上的厚奶油 (Heavy Cream)，並在加奶油前先將糖漿與氣泡水輕拌稀釋，絕對不會起豆腐花！
enDescription: A dream encounter of juicy summer white peach and thick cream. Pastel blush pink meets cascading cream clouds, opening with crisp bubbly peach sweetness and finishing with a velvety vanilla milk finish.
enSecretTips: Curdle Prevention: Peach syrup contains mild fruit acidity. Always use heavy cream (30%+ fat) and stir syrup with soda before adding cream to prevent curdling!

name: 覆盆子紅絲絨奶霜蘇打
style: 經典意式紅莓雪融特調
description: 覆盆子野莓特有的酸甜明亮與濃郁香草奶霜相碰撞。豔麗的深紅寶石色在純白奶油傾注的瞬間激發出紅絲絨大理石紋理，果香高揚不膩口。

ingredients.name: 新鮮紅樹莓 / 薄荷葉

steps.title: 雙風味糖漿黃金拼配
steps.instruction: 杯底壓入 3 泵覆盆子糖漿 + 1 泵香草糖漿，香草能中和莓果微酸，使整體更圓潤飽滿。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 3 pumps Raspberry syrup + 1 pump Vanilla syrup into the glass.

steps.title: 加冰與注水
steps.instruction: 加滿碎冰，沿杯壁溫和注入冰氣泡水至 8 分滿。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with crushed ice, then gently pour cold club soda along the glass wall to 80% full.

steps.title: 微調混合底液
steps.instruction: 用吧勺快速上下拉動 2 次使紅莓糖漿與氣泡水融合為透明深紅色液體。
steps.enInstruction: Gently pull the bar spoon up and down twice to blend the syrup into a translucent ruby base.

steps.title: 頂部奶油流瀑
steps.instruction: 將 35ml 半乳奶油對準冰塊正中輕緩傾倒，奶油會順著冰塊縫隙如絲綢般垂墜，呈現極致拉花大理石紋。
steps.enInstruction: Pour 35ml half-and-half directly onto the top ice, watching the marble ribbons form.

steps.title: 點綴新鮮莓果
steps.instruction: 在頂部冰塊上擺放 3 顆新鮮樹莓與一小簇翠綠薄荷葉，即可上桌拍照！
steps.enInstruction: Top with 3 fresh raspberries and a fresh mint sprig.

secretTips: 覆盆子糖漿搭配 1 泵香草糖漿是專業 Barista 的不傳之秘，香草中的香草醛能完美包裹野莓的果酸，提升入口順滑度。
enDescription: Tart, aromatic wild red raspberries meet rich vanilla cream. Vibrant ruby red turns into velvet ribbons as pure cream cascades down, delivering bright fruitiness that never feels heavy.
enSecretTips: Pro Barista Secret: Adding 1 pump of vanilla syrup softens the sharp berry acidity and wraps the palate in smooth sweetness.

name: 西西里血橙奶霜蘇打
style: 意式柑橘島嶼度假風
description: 經典橘子雪糕 (Orange Creamsicle) 的意式蘇打化演繹。西西里血橙熱烈奔放的柑橘芳香，與頂部濃厚的香草奶霜完美互補，彷彿一口咬下夏日的香草橙雪糕。

steps.title: 注糖漿與橙香打底
steps.instruction: 在杯底加入血橙糖漿與香草糖漿，取一瓣新鮮橙皮輕輕對著杯口擠壓出柑橘精油香氣。
steps.enInstruction: Add 3.5 pumps Blood Orange syrup and 0.5 pump Vanilla syrup. Express fresh orange peel over the glass rim.

steps.title: 加冰與氣泡水
steps.instruction: 滿杯冰塊，傾斜杯子注入冰氣泡水，微攪拌至金橘通透。
steps.enInstruction: Fill glass with ice, tilt and pour cold sparkling water, stir lightly until golden orange.

steps.title: 浮頂注入奶霜
steps.instruction: 透過吧勺背面輕輕倒上 30ml 鮮奶油，呈現橘白交織的雲朵層次。
steps.enInstruction: Drizzle 30ml cream over the back of a bar spoon for a two-tone cloud float.

steps.title: 杯沿卡上鮮橙片
steps.instruction: 杯口切口卡入一片帶皮血橙片即可享用。
steps.enInstruction: Cut a notch in a fresh blood orange wheel and slot it onto the glass rim.

secretTips: 杯口擠壓柑橘皮釋放的天然檸檬烯 (Limonene) 精油霧氣，能在一靠近杯口時就聞到令人神清氣爽的地中海果園氣息。
enDescription: The Italian Soda rendition of the iconic orange creamsicle! Energetic Sicilian blood orange citrus aromas paired with a thick vanilla cream float—tastes like a bite of frozen summer citrus gelato.
enSecretTips: Expressing orange peel over the rim releases natural limonene citrus oils, giving an instant burst of Mediterranean orchard aroma on your first sip.

name: 草莓短蛋糕奶霜蘇打
style: 甜品系意式特調
description: 將法式甜點草莓短蛋糕解構裝進氣泡杯中！新鮮草莓糖漿與香甜烤杏仁/香草底蘊，頂部厚厚的雪白鮮奶油，每一口都是幸福甜美。

steps.title: 草莓與香草雙糖漿
steps.instruction: 杯底打入 3 泵草莓糖漿與 1 泵香草糖漿。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 3 pumps Strawberry syrup and 1 pump Vanilla syrup into the glass.

steps.title: 加冰注水
steps.instruction: 碎冰填滿八分，倒入冰氣泡水並快速攪勻成粉紅寶石色。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with crushed ice, pour cold soda, and stir until pastel pink.

steps.title: 倒入鮮奶油並加雪頂
steps.instruction: 頂部倒入 30ml 鮮奶油，再額外擠上一座高高的鮮打奶油山，擺上半顆新鮮草莓。
steps.enInstruction: Pour 30ml cream, then top with a generous swirl of whipped cream and half a fresh strawberry.

secretTips: 若想要烘焙短蛋糕的黃油香氣，可額外加半泵 Torani 英國太妃 (English Toffee) 或短酥餅糖漿！
enDescription: Deconstructed strawberry shortcake in a bubbly glass! Sweet ripe strawberry syrup with a touch of vanilla warmth, topped with a tall snowy peak of whipped cream and fresh strawberries.
enSecretTips: For a buttery bakery aroma, add a half pump of Torani English Toffee or Shortbread syrup!

name: 藍莓黑加侖雪融蘇打
style: 北歐森林夢幻特調
description: 深紫色藍莓與黑加侖深邃漿果的幽香，搭配純白奶油在杯中如同星雲漫卷，清爽的氣泡帶來森林漿果的奔放爆汁感。

steps.title: 藍莓糖漿入杯
steps.instruction: 高球杯底壓入 4 泵純濃藍莓糖漿。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 4 pumps concentrated blueberry syrup into the highball glass.

steps.title: 注冰放藍莓
steps.instruction: 加入半杯冰塊，撒入 4 粒新鮮藍莓，再加滿冰塊夾住藍莓。
steps.enInstruction: Add half a cup of ice, drop in 4 fresh blueberries, then fill to the top with ice.

steps.title: 慢注氣泡水
steps.instruction: 注入氣泡水至 8 分滿，輕輕抽拉混合成紫晶色。
steps.enInstruction: Pour chilled sparkling water to 80% full and gently stir to create an amethyst purple base.

steps.title: 雪融雲朵注入
steps.instruction: 將 30ml 厚奶油輕輕倒在浮冰表面，觀賞紫色與白色在冰晶間交織的雪融效果。
steps.enInstruction: Pour 30ml heavy cream on top of the floating ice and watch the purple-white cloud melt downwards.

secretTips: 冷凍藍莓可以充當天然冰球，既美觀又不會在融化時稀釋飲品濃度。
enDescription: Deep violet blueberries and earthy blackcurrant notes swirling with velvety white cream like a cosmic nebula. Crisp carbonation releases bursts of forest berry sweetness.
enSecretTips: Frozen blueberries work as natural ice balls that chill the drink without diluting flavor as they thaw.

name: 西西里血橙迷迭香氣泡特飲
style: 西西里島陽光草本特調
description: 西西里島熾熱陽光下的靈魂特調。無酒精版意式 Spritz，濃烈血橙的酸甜交織著新鮮迷迭香木質松香，海鹽微晶激發深層柑橘甜味，極致醒神消暑。

ingredients.name: San Pellegrino 意大利聖培露氣泡礦泉水
ingredients.amazonSearchQuery: San Pellegrino Sparkling Natural Mineral Water

ingredients.name: 新鮮迷迭香枝
ingredients.enNote: Clap between palms to release aroma

steps.title: 拍打迷迭香
steps.instruction: 將新鮮迷迭香放在雙手手掌間用力拍擊一次（Slap），破壞表面油腺釋放出撲鼻的草本松香。
steps.tip: 拍擊比揉搓更能保留整枝迷迭香的高級挺括姿態。
steps.enInstruction: Slap a fresh rosemary sprig firmly between your palms to rupture essential oil glands.
steps.enTip: Slapping releases intense aroma without bruising the stem.

steps.title: 糖漿與鮮檸打底
steps.instruction: 杯中注入 4 泵血橙糖漿與 15ml 現擠檸檬汁。
steps.enInstruction: Add 4 pumps blood orange syrup and 15ml fresh lemon juice into the glass.

steps.title: 加冰並立入迷迭香
steps.instruction: 加滿大方冰塊，將迷迭香枝直挺挺地插在冰塊與杯壁之間。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with ice cubes and stand the rosemary sprig upright against the glass wall.

steps.title: 注水與海鹽點睛
steps.instruction: 注入冰鎮聖培露氣泡水至滿，頂部灑上一小撮研磨海鹽，稍微攪動一次即可飲用。
steps.enInstruction: Top with chilled San Pellegrino sparkling water, sprinkle sea salt on top, and give one gentle stir.

secretTips: 微量海鹽（0.5g）不僅不會變鹹，反而能抑制柑橘微澀，並在舌尖放大水果糖分的甘美度，這就是意大利南部沿海調飲的千年秘訣。
equipmentNeeded: 高球杯或大肚葡萄酒杯
enDescription: The spirit of Sicily under Mediterranean sun! A zero-alcohol Italian Spritz combining bold blood orange citrus with aromatic pine notes of fresh rosemary and sea salt microcrystals.
enSecretTips: A pinch of sea salt (0.5g) suppresses citrus bitterness and magnifies sweet fruit notes on the palate—a southern Italian mixology secret.

name: 阿馬爾菲檸檬冰爽蘇打
style: 阿馬爾菲海岸傳奇檸檬風味
description: 阿馬爾菲懸崖檸檬園的清冽海風！還原意大利國寶檸檬酒 (Limoncello) 經典風味的無酒精蘇打。檸檬皮精油與高酸度天然檸檬汁交融，極具衝擊力的爽脆氣泡。

ingredients.name: Monin / Torani 檸檬風味糖漿

steps.title: 現壓檸檬與糖漿調和
steps.instruction: 杯底加入 3 泵檸檬糖漿與 20ml 現榨檸檬汁，將一片黃檸檬用吧勺稍加碾壓釋出皮油。
steps.enInstruction: Add 3 pumps lemon syrup, 20ml fresh lemon juice, and muddle a lemon wheel lightly.

steps.title: 注冰加氣泡水
steps.instruction: 加滿純淨冰塊，緩緩注入冰氣泡水至滿杯。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with pure ice cubes and slowly pour chilled sparkling water to the top.

steps.title: 飾以薄荷與檸檬片
steps.instruction: 插入另一片黃檸檬與一簇薄荷葉裝飾。
steps.enInstruction: Crown with another fresh lemon wheel and a vibrant sprig of fresh mint.

secretTips: 黃檸檬（Eureka或阿馬爾菲檸檬）香氣比青檸更溫柔多汁，碾壓果皮時注意只壓黃色油胞層，不要過度擠壓白色海綿層，以防苦澀。
enDescription: Breezy sea winds along the Amalfi lemon cliffs! A non-alcoholic Italian soda capturing the soul of Limoncello. High-voltage lemon zest, real lemon juice, and effervescent bubbles.
enSecretTips: Yellow Amalfi or Eureka lemons have sweeter aromatic oils than green limes. Press only the outer peel to avoid bitter white pith.

name: 粉紅葡萄柚海鹽氣泡飲
style: 摩登地中海微鹹果香特調
description: 葡萄柚標誌性的紅寶石色澤與微苦清香，佐以一小撮海鹽抹邊，瞬間鎖住果香回甘。清爽無負擔，是追求小資精緻生活的人氣首選。

steps.title: 海鹽半杯抹邊 (Half-Rim)
steps.instruction: 用西柚片沿杯口外緣潤濕半圈，在鹽盤中輕蘸一下沾上細密海鹽晶體。
steps.tip: 只抹半邊可以讓品飲者自由選擇喝鹽邊或無鹽邊，體驗不同層次。
steps.enInstruction: Moisten half of the glass rim with a grapefruit slice, then dip into coarse sea salt.
steps.enTip: A half-rim lets the drinker choose salty or unsalted sips.

steps.title: 糖漿與果汁調底
steps.instruction: 在杯底加入 4 泵紅西柚糖漿與 30ml 鮮榨紅西柚汁。
steps.enInstruction: Add 4 pumps red grapefruit syrup and 30ml fresh grapefruit juice.

steps.title: 加冰與注水
steps.instruction: 輕柔填滿冰塊，注入冷藏氣泡水至滿杯，輕攪兩次。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with ice, gently pour cold sparkling water to the top, and stir twice.

secretTips: 紅西柚的微苦來自柚皮苷，海鹽中的鈉離子會迅速麻痹舌部苦味感受器，讓果香更甜更純淨。
enDescription: Ruby grapefruit's signature blush hue and aromatic bittersweetness, accented with a fine sea-salt half-rim that locks in fruit sweetness. Crisp, sophisticated, and revitalizing.
enSecretTips: Sodium in sea salt temporarily desensitizes bitter receptors on the tongue, allowing pure grapefruit sweetness to shine.

name: 佛手柑微苦草本氣泡 (Sanbittèr 風格)
style: 意式開胃酒 Aperitivo 復刻風格
description: 復刻意大利經典紅色開胃氣泡水 Sanbittèr 的迷人滋味！佛手柑柑橘、龍膽草與大黃苦甜草本香氣，深紅剔透，配上一大塊老冰與橄欖，是成人的精緻氣泡享受。

ingredients.name: Monin 意式苦味糖漿 (Italian Bitter Syrup) 或佛手柑糖漿

steps.title: 苦味草本底注入
steps.instruction: 杯中壓入 4 泵苦味糖漿。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 4 pumps Italian bitter or bergamot syrup into the glass.

steps.title: 大方冰與注水
steps.instruction: 放入 2-3 塊透明老冰塊，緩慢注入冰鎮聖培露氣泡水，攪拌均勻。
steps.enInstruction: Add large clear ice cubes, pour cold sparkling mineral water, and stir gently.

steps.title: 橙皮噴香與橄欖點綴
steps.instruction: 雙手扭轉鮮橙皮噴灑精油，投入杯中，放上一枚綠橄欖串。
steps.enInstruction: Twist orange peel over the glass to express oils, drop inside, and garnish with a green Cerignola olive on a cocktail pick.

secretTips: 苦甜平衡是意式調飲的最高境界，搭配一小碟堅果或意式風乾火腿片，在家即可體驗米蘭酒吧的歡聚時光。
equipmentNeeded: 古典威士忌岩石杯或柯林杯
enDescription: Replicating Italy's legendary ruby aperitivo soda! Bergamot citrus, gentian root, and bittersweet herbs over clear rocks with an orange twist and green olive—an adult Italian ritual.
enSecretTips: Bittersweet balance is the crown jewel of Italian bar culture. Pair with roasted nuts or prosciutto for a true Milanese aperitivo.

name: 電光藍柑夏威夷氣泡
style: 加勒比海夢幻蔚藍特調
description: 無酒精版海洋之星！純淨深邃的加勒比蔚藍色，散發著誘人的柑橘橙皮果香，搭配清爽檸檬酸度與激爽氣泡，在碎冰中折射出令人驚嘆的霓虹光彩。

ingredients.name: Monin 莫林藍柑糖漿 (Blue Curaçao)

steps.title: 藍柑糖漿打底
steps.instruction: 杯底精準壓入 3.5 泵純藍柑糖漿與 15ml 青檸汁。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 3.5 pumps Blue Curaçao syrup and 15ml fresh lime juice into the glass.

steps.title: 緊貼杯壁放青檸片
steps.instruction: 將青檸片貼在杯身兩側，倒入八分滿碎冰固定。
steps.enInstruction: Press lime wheels against the inside wall and pack with crushed ice to secure them.

steps.title: 注水與分層拉花
steps.instruction: 沿杯壁極慢注入冰氣泡水，營造出底部深海蔚藍、頂部淺藍冰川的漸層效果！
steps.enInstruction: Slowly pour cold soda down the glass wall for a deep blue to icy cyan gradient.

steps.title: 櫻桃點睛
steps.instruction: 頂部放置一顆鮮紅黑櫻桃，形成強烈紅藍對撞視覺效果。
steps.enInstruction: Place a glossy red Maraschino cherry on top for an eye-catching blue-red contrast.

secretTips: 如果不攪拌直接喝，頂層是清新檸檬氣泡，越到底層柑橘甜味越濃；拍照後用吸管抽動攪勻則通體呈現迷人透明海島藍。
enDescription: A non-alcoholic Ocean Star! Striking Caribbean cyan blue, sweet citrus orange peel aroma, crisp lime acidity, and dancing bubbles reflecting neon hues through crushed ice.
enSecretTips: If sipping with a straw, the top is crisp lime and bottom is sweet orange. Stirring creates a uniform tropical ocean blue.

name: 盛夏百香芒芒氣泡特調
style: 熱帶島嶼熱情風味
description: 熱帶黃金雙果強強聯手！熟透芒果的綿軟甘甜包裹著新鮮百香果的清亮果酸，每吸一口都有濃濃果香伴隨強勁氣泡在口中雀躍。

steps.title: 雙果糖漿與新鮮果肉
steps.instruction: 杯中注入百香果糖漿與芒果糖漿，挖入一勺帶籽的新鮮百香果泥。
steps.enInstruction: Add 2.5 pumps Passion Fruit syrup, 1.5 pumps Mango syrup, and 1 tbsp seeded passion fruit pulp.

steps.title: 加冰注水
steps.instruction: 加滿碎冰，緩慢倒入冰鎮氣泡水並攪動，讓黑色百香果籽如繁星般均勻懸浮。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with crushed ice, slowly pour sparkling water, and stir to distribute the black seeds evenly.

secretTips: 加入一勺帶籽真果肉能大幅提升整杯飲品的「現調手作感」，咀嚼時香脆的果籽更是口感亮點！
enDescription: A power duo of ripe mango sweetness and tangy passion fruit! Every sip brings explosive tropical perfume and crunchy edible seeds floating in vibrant bubbles.
enSecretTips: Adding a spoonful of real seeded passion fruit pulp dramatically boosts authentic handcrafted mouthfeel!

name: 綠野青檸薄荷蘇打 (意式無酒精莫吉托)
style: 經典薄荷青檸清涼特調
description: 無酒精莫吉托的意式清涼版！綠薄荷葉的穿透性涼感與青檸精油在杯中被徹底釋放，純淨的氣泡水洗滌一身疲憊，是夏日戶外運動後的救贖。

ingredients.name: Torani 青檸/純蔗糖糖漿 (Lime / Pure Cane)

steps.title: 輕壓薄荷與青檸
steps.instruction: 杯底放入青檸角與薄荷葉，用木質壓汁棒輕柔按壓 4-5 次擠出汁液與精油（切勿搗爛薄荷產生草腥味）。
steps.enInstruction: Place lime wedges and mint leaves in glass. Press gently 4-5 times with a wooden muddler.

steps.title: 注糖漿與碎冰
steps.instruction: 壓入青檸糖漿，加滿碎冰。
steps.enInstruction: Add 3.5 pumps lime or cane syrup and pack glass with crushed ice.

steps.title: 注水大翻攪
steps.instruction: 注入冰鎮氣泡水，用長柄吧勺由底向上用力抽拉 3 次，使綠葉與青檸在冰晶中均勻分佈。
steps.enInstruction: Pour cold soda and lift the bar spoon from bottom to top 3 times to distribute mint evenly.

secretTips: 薄荷葉千千萬萬不要用大力搗成碎末！只壓出香氣即可，否則葉綠素受損會釋放出苦澀的割草味。
enDescription: The refreshing Italian version of a virgin mojito! Spearmint coolness and fresh lime oils crushed in sparkling soda, washing away heat with crisp effervescence.
enSecretTips: Never violently shred mint leaves! Press gently to extract aromatics; tearing releases bitter chlorophyll.

name: 黑莓晨光漸層氣泡飲
style: 日落暮色雙層漸變
description: 如晨曦初升的雙色漸層！底部是成熟黑莓深邃濃艷的野性漿果紅，頂部是甜橙與檸檬的清透金黃，微酸甘醇，視覺與味覺的雙重饗宴。

steps.title: 黑莓重糖漿沉底
steps.instruction: 黑莓糖漿 3 泵直接壓在杯底。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 3 pumps blackberry syrup directly into the bottom.

steps.title: 滿杯碎冰屏障
steps.instruction: 將碎冰填至杯口，形成密集的物理密度阻隔層。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with crushed ice right to the rim, creating a physical density barrier.

steps.title: 注氣泡水至七分滿
steps.instruction: 沿杯壁輕注氣泡水，微攪拌下半部使黑莓融入下層。
steps.enInstruction: Gently pour sparkling water down the wall and lightly stir only the bottom half.

steps.title: 頂層浮注鮮柳橙汁
steps.instruction: 透過吧勺背面，將 60ml 鮮橙汁極其緩慢地浮倒在最頂部，達成絕美的紫紅到金黃漸變！
steps.enInstruction: Drizzle 60ml fresh orange juice over the back of a bar spoon onto the top ice for a dual-tone sunrise!

secretTips: 比重原理：高糖漿比重大於氣泡水，橙汁比重介於二者之間。只要有緊湊碎冰緩衝並用吧勺引流，任何人都能調出專業漸層！
enDescription: A sunrise in a glass! Deep, wild purple blackberry syrup anchored at the bottom with bright golden fresh orange juice floating on top, divided by glistening crushed ice.
enSecretTips: Density physics: High-sugar syrup has higher specific gravity than soda, while fresh orange juice floats naturally over dense crushed ice.

name: 紅寶石石榴氣泡特調
style: 經典石榴糖漿紅寶石特飲
description: 經典紅石榴糖漿 (Grenadine) 的純淨演繹。如同盛滿紅寶石的水晶杯，石榴的明麗深邃與氣泡水的跳躍感交織，佐以青檸片，清爽甘甜回味悠長。

steps.title: 石榴糖漿入杯
steps.instruction: 杯中注入 4 泵紅石榴糖漿與 10ml 青檸汁。
steps.enInstruction: Add 4 pumps pomegranate syrup and 10ml fresh lime juice.

steps.title: 加冰注水調勻
steps.instruction: 滿杯冰塊，注入冰氣泡水並優雅攪勻，整杯透出晶瑩剔透的石榴紅。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with ice cubes, pour cold sparkling water, and stir until brilliant crystal ruby red.

secretTips: 真石榴糖漿（Pomegranate）比普通人工色素紅石榴水更加深邃帶有微澀單寧感，搭配青檸汁更是絕配。
enDescription: Pure vintage elegance. Glowing like cut rubies in crystal, rich pomegranate grenadine meets lively soda bubbles and fresh lime for a crisp, timeless thirst-quencher.
enSecretTips: Real pomegranate syrup offers deeper, complex fruit tannins than artificial red sugar dye.

name: 法國接骨木花青提氣泡
style: 歐陸貴族花香特調
description: 米其林餐廳首選的草本花香氣泡！法國接骨木花 (Elderflower) 獨特的白花香氣，宛如荔枝與麝香葡萄在舌尖綻放。搭配爽脆的陽光玫瑰青提，高雅清幽。

ingredients.name: 新鮮白葡萄汁 / 青檸汁

steps.title: 花香糖漿打底
steps.instruction: 杯底壓入 3.5 泵接骨木花糖漿與青檸汁。
steps.enInstruction: Add 3.5 pumps elderflower syrup and 20ml white grape or lime juice.

steps.title: 投入青提與冰塊
steps.instruction: 將切半的綠提子放入杯中，加滿透明純淨冰塊。
steps.enInstruction: Add halved seedless green grapes, then fill glass with crystal clear ice.

steps.title: 慢注入氣泡水
steps.instruction: 注入冰鎮聖培露氣泡水，輕輕提拉吧勺，點綴薄荷葉即可！
steps.enInstruction: Pour cold San Pellegrino sparkling water, lift bar spoon gently, and crown with fresh mint.

secretTips: 接骨木花的香氣分子極易揮發，氣泡水水溫越低，香氣在口中綻放得越持久震撼。
enDescription: The star botanical spritz of European bistros. French elderflower brings delicate notes of lychee and muscat grape, paired with crisp halved green seedless grapes.
enSecretTips: Elderflower aroma compounds are delicate and volatile. The colder your sparkling water, the longer the floral bouquet lingers.

name: 普羅旺斯薰衣草檸檬蘇打
style: 南法薰衣草莊園風情
description: 夢幻紫色療癒特飲。真正的普羅旺斯藍色薰衣草糖漿，散發著舒緩身心的草本芳香，與現榨檸檬汁的酸爽完美契合，一口喝下彷彿置身南法紫色花田。

ingredients.name: 乾薰衣草花枝 / 檸檬片

steps.title: 紫色糖漿與鮮檸調和
steps.instruction: 杯中注入 3 泵薰衣草糖漿與 20ml 現榨檸檬汁。
steps.enInstruction: Add 3 pumps lavender syrup and 20ml fresh lemon juice.

steps.title: 注冰加水
steps.instruction: 加滿純淨冰塊，緩緩注入冰氣泡水至滿杯，用吧勺優雅攪勻呈現透明薰衣草紫。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with ice, slowly pour cold sparkling water, and stir until glowing pastel purple.

steps.title: 花枝裝飾
steps.instruction: 頂部卡上一片黃檸檬，插上一小束乾燥薰衣草花枝。
steps.enInstruction: Garnish with a lemon wheel and a sprig of dried French lavender.

secretTips: 薰衣草的精油氣味較濃，3 泵（約 22ml）為黃金臨界點，過量容易產生肥皂水錯覺，檸檬汁的酸度能巧妙鎮住花香。
enDescription: A calming pastel violet wonder. Genuine Provence lavender syrup releases soothing floral aromas, balanced by the bright tartness of freshly squeezed lemon juice.
enSecretTips: Lavender is potent: 3 pumps (approx. 22ml) is the golden sweet spot. Fresh lemon juice harmonizes floral notes cleanly.

name: 大馬士革玫瑰荔枝氣泡飲
style: 浪漫宮廷花園特調
description: 花果香氣的絕代雙驕！大馬士革玫瑰高貴柔美的花瓣香，與水嫩多汁的白荔枝果香渾然天成。杯底沉浮著晶瑩荔枝果肉，仙氣飄飄。

ingredients.name: 剝皮白荔枝肉 (罐頭或新鮮)
食用可食乾燥玫瑰花瓣

steps.title: 玫瑰荔枝拼配與放果肉
steps.instruction: 杯底壓入 2 泵玫瑰糖漿與 2 泵荔枝糖漿，投入 2 顆飽滿雪白荔枝果肉。
steps.enInstruction: Add 2 pumps rose syrup, 2 pumps lychee syrup, and drop in 2 peeled whole white lychees.

steps.title: 加冰注水
steps.instruction: 放入冰塊，注入冰冷氣泡水並攪勻至透亮櫻粉色。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with ice, pour cold sparkling water, and stir until translucent cherry blossom pink.

steps.title: 撒上粉嫩玫瑰花瓣
steps.instruction: 在杯頂冰塊上輕柔灑下幾瓣食用乾燥玫瑰花瓣。
steps.enInstruction: Gently scatter edible dried organic rose petals across the top ice.

secretTips: 玫瑰與荔枝共用相同的香氣芳香烴分子，二者結合是世界調香大師 Pierre Hermé（Ispahan）的標誌性配方。
enDescription: The timeless Ispahan floral harmony! Noble Damask rose petal aromas blended with succulent white lychee juice, floating with tender lychee fruit and dried rose petals.
enSecretTips: Rose and lychee share identical aroma aromatic hydrocarbons, making them a match made in heaven.

name: 羅勒西瓜夏日清泉
style: 托斯卡納農莊清甜特飲
description: 托斯卡納夏日餐桌上的消暑奇蹟。鮮甜解渴的西瓜果香，融入意式甜羅勒 (Sweet Basil) 標誌性的胡椒丁香香氣，鹹甜微涼，一口降溫 5 度！

steps.title: 掌心拍打羅勒葉
steps.instruction: 將 4 片意式甜羅勒放在手心拍打一次釋出精油，放入杯底。
steps.enInstruction: Slap 4 sweet basil leaves between palms to awaken aromatic oils, then place in glass.

steps.title: 注入糖漿與青檸汁
steps.instruction: 壓入 3.5 泵西瓜糖漿與 15ml 青檸汁，用吧勺輕壓羅勒幾次。
steps.enInstruction: Add 3.5 pumps watermelon syrup and 15ml lime juice. Press basil lightly with spoon.

steps.title: 加冰注水調勻
steps.instruction: 加入滿杯冰塊，注入冰冷氣泡水並攪動均勻，放一頂羅勒葉裝飾。
steps.enInstruction: Fill with ice, pour cold sparkling water, stir, and garnish with a basil leaf tip.

secretTips: 必須使用意式甜羅勒（Sweet Basil），切勿使用泰式九層塔，甜羅勒葉片柔嫩香氣溫和，才不會掩蓋西瓜的鮮甜。
enDescription: A summer picnic revelation from Tuscany! Crisp juicy watermelon meets sweet Italian basil with subtle clove and pepper notes—sweet, savory, and cooling.
enSecretTips: Always use Italian Sweet Basil (not Thai holy basil); sweet basil is tender and complements sweet watermelon seamlessly.

name: 零卡白桃茉莉氣泡水
style: 生酮低碳 0 熱量特調
description: 減脂期與生酮人群的狂喜！採用 Torani 無糖白桃糖漿（0卡三氯蔗糖配方），保留了水蜜桃鮮甜多汁的風味，伴隨清冷茉莉茶香與綿密氣泡，0 負擔暢飲！

ingredients.name: Torani Sugar Free 無糖白桃糖漿

steps.title: 壓入零卡糖漿
steps.instruction: 杯底壓入 4 泵 Torani 無糖白桃糖漿與青檸汁。
steps.enInstruction: Pump 4 pumps Torani Sugar-Free White Peach syrup and 10ml fresh lime juice.

steps.title: 注冰滿杯氣泡水
steps.instruction: 加滿碎冰，倒入冰鎮氣泡水，攪勻即可，整杯熱量小於 5 大卡！
steps.enInstruction: Fill with crushed ice, pour chilled sparkling water, stir well, and enjoy under 5 calories!

secretTips: 三氯蔗糖 (Sucralose) 不參與人體糖代謝，不引起血糖波動，口感極度逼真且無後苦味。
enDescription: Pure indulgence with zero guilt! Crafted with Torani Sugar-Free White Peach syrup (0 calories, 0 carbs), delivering juicy peach aroma and sparkling fizz with under 5 calories per glass.
enSecretTips: Sucralose sweetener causes zero blood sugar spikes, tastes crisp and sweet, and has no bitter aftertaste.
